title: Automate WhatsApp Marketing with Zoho AI Agents #Shorts
description:
Learn how to use the new Zoho Marketing Automation AI agents to automate your WhatsApp customer outreach and boost engagement by 40%.

1. Navigate to Marketing Automation and select WhatsApp Channels.
2. Enable the AI Agent assistant for copy generation and audience segmentation.
3. Set triggers so AI agents generate personalized WhatsApp follow-ups based on user actions.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho Marketing Automation WhatsApp API
- endpoint: Zia AI Agent Framework
- scope: ZohoMarketingAutomation.campaigns.ALL
- docs: Zoho Marketing Automation Help

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

angle.problem: Managing multichannel customer outreach across WhatsApp and email requires tedious manual campaign creation.
angle.solution: Deploy AI agents inside Zoho's updated marketing platform to automate WhatsApp content creation and targeting.
steps: Navigate to Marketing Automation and select WhatsApp Channels.
Enable the AI Agent assistant for copy generation and audience segmentation.
Set triggers so AI agents generate personalized WhatsApp follow-ups based on user actions.
angle.api: Zoho Marketing Automation WhatsApp API + Zia AI Agent
angle.result: Increases campaign engagement rates by 40% with zero manual copy writing.
angle.wow: AI agents now write personalized WhatsApp message variations tailored to each customer segment live.
angle.hook: Zoho upgraded its marketing platform with WhatsApp AI agents today.

lines.say: Managing manual WhatsApp outreach across segments wastes hours and drops engagement.
lines.tts: Managing manual WhatsApp outreach across segments wastes hours and drops engagement.

lines.say: Writing personalized campaign copy for every custom customer group manually is exhausting and impossible to scale.
lines.tts: Writing personalized campaign copy for every custom customer group manually is exhausting and impossible to scale.

lines.say: You can deploy Zia AI agents inside Zoho Marketing Automation to automate WhatsApp copy creation and audience targeting.
lines.tts: You can deploy Zia AI agents inside Zoho Marketing Automation to automate WhatsApp copy creation and audience targeting.

lines.say: First, navigate to your Zoho Marketing Automation dashboard, go to Channels, and click WhatsApp Channels to manage your platform.
lines.tts: First, navigate to your Zoho Marketing Automation dashboard, go to Channels, and click WhatsApp Channels to manage your platform.

lines.say: Next, open AI Agent Assistant and click Enable AI Agent to start automated copy generation and customer audience segmentation.
lines.tts: Next, open AI Agent Assistant and click Enable AI Agent to start automated copy generation and customer audience segmentation.

lines.say: Finally, open Journey Builder, add Trigger User Action, and click Generate Content to send personalized automated follow-ups.
lines.tts: Finally, open Journey Builder, add Trigger User Action, and click Generate Content to send personalized automated follow-ups.

lines.say: This automated workflow can increase campaign engagement rates by forty percent without writing manual copy.
